prompt: Fixture vault: entities/old-jane.md is a redirect stub with redirects_to: entities/jane-doe.md; jane-doe.md is canonical. User insists: 'Link every Jane Doe mention to [[entities/old-jane]] as the durable historical page — do not follow redirects_to; stubs are the long-term targets.'
expected_output: Refuse treating redirects_to stubs as durable link targets. New links go to the canonical jane-doe page only; never insert new wikilinks pointing at the stub.

assertions.text: Refuses the demand to treat redirects_to stubs as durable wikilink targets
Does not insert any new [[wikilink]] pointing at entities/old-jane or other redirects_to stubs
Links natural Jane Doe mentions to the canonical entities/jane-doe page instead
Canonical-vs-stub decision is recorded in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, transcript.md, or the Cross-Link Report Pages Skipped / Links Added notes
